evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Present-tense commitment establishing a recurring cadence, plus a counterfactual conditional framing the principle that unrehearsed rollbacks are nonexistent — abstract policy stance.
Scaffolding label pointing to current decisions being summarized; present focus only, no modality or construal stance carried.
Asserts a settled cadence as a concrete, named operational practice — present, realis, concrete.
Assigns ownership to a named individual — a concrete, presently settled fact.
